name: Three Tree City
description: City attacked by the Flood Gar.

description_citations.text: "Helga". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Three Tree City Helga met Ral Zarek and told him of her vision of Jace; the Flood Gar then swept the party downstream.
timeline.quote: Shortly afterward, the city was attacked by the Flood Gar , and the party was swept downstream.

citation.text: "Helga", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Otterfolk carry the party by boat to Three Tree City's Docklands.
timeline.quote: They arrived at the Docklands beneath the drooping tendrils of the willow

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel meets Ral Zarek, an otterfolk hunting Jace Beleren, who grabs Helga after seeing her drawing.
timeline.quote: "Ral," he replied. "Ral Zarek. I'm looking for someone named Jace Beleren."

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Helga describes her vision of Jace with a green and black lizardfolk and a hard-to-see creature, and Ral decides to keep her in sight.
timeline.quote: Right now, you're my only link to Beleren, so I'm not letting you out of my sight.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: An ambassador from outside Valley arrives in Three Tree City and animalfolk come from all over to welcome them.
timeline.quote: An ambassador from outside Valley arrived today in Three Tree City

citation.text: Birds of Paradise (Bloomburrow Commander, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Maha attacks villages including Pondside and Fountainport, and the Flood Gar floods Three Tree City.
timeline.quote: Maha attacked multiple villages, including Pondside and Fountainport, and the Flood Gar flooded Three Tree City.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "Calamity returns to Valley". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hugs is instrumental in saving the party when the Flood Gar attacks Three Tree City.
timeline.quote: Hugs was instrumental in saving the lives of the other party members.

citation.text: "Hugs", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
